title: sqlite
responsibility: Preserves the generated-model SQLite factory address by delegating adapter construction to the canonical SqliteAdapter implementation.

inputs.name: createSqliteAdapter.db
inputs.description: Caller-owned SQLite database handle passed to the canonical adapter factory.

inputs.name: createSqliteAdapter.models
inputs.description: Source-declared model definitions supplied to the canonical factory.

outputs.name: createSqliteAdapter
outputs.description: Canonical SQLite persistence adapter wrapping the supplied database and model definitions.

errors.name: Adapter construction failure
errors.description: Exceptions from canonical adapter construction propagate unchanged; this compatibility factory adds no validation or storage methods.
